## Biodiversity Index Function

CONTRACT

inputs= vector of individuals of each species (n), summed number of individuals of all species (N), n is a vector and N is the sum of n.

output = biodiversity index value between 0 and 1, indicates biodiversity with lower values indicating lower biodiversity.

parameters = species and total –\> (sum (n(n-1))) / (N((N-1)))

```{r}
# make a dataset - used the documentation data
plants <- data.frame(
  species = c("Woodrush","Holly (seedlings)", "Bramble","Yorkshire Fog", "Sedge"),
   count = c(2, 8, 1, 1, 3)
)
plants

```

### Run the Function

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("R/biodiversity_function_royal.R"))

# run it
biodiv_index(plants$count, sum(plants$count))
```
